insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $31,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $400,267 to $400,267, a 1x increase.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 7 (+4 over 90 days) and market heat at 31 (-6).
